title: Service account key file: sensitivity of the identifying fields
summary: Whether project_id, private_key_id, client_email, client_id and the x509 certificate URLs of a service account key file are confidential or public.
rationale: Google's page calls only the private portion private. The key id and service account email identify a key and an account and are needed to use or audit it, but the pages read make no statement either way, so a must-flag or must-not-flag expectation would be an unsupported claim.

expectation.rationale: Left unresolved. The pages read (key creation, workload identity federation) state that the private portion is private and that a credential configuration file needs no confidentiality; neither says whether the identifying fields of a key file are confidential. A maintainer policy decision, or a provider statement on the key id and client_email, would settle it.

sources.supports: No statement on the confidentiality of the non-private fields.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
